llm_response.reason: Rusty Zipper shows characteristics of a legitimate e-commerce website: consistent thematic branding (vintage clothing), standard payment methods (PayPal, Visa, Mastercard), public business information (since 1995), recognizable social media links, and customer support features (shipping, returns, contact).
